question: Which users started the most topics in Dev?
sql:
SELECT u.username,
       COUNT(*) AS topic_count
  FROM topics t
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = t.user_id
  JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = t.category_id
 WHERE c.name = 'Dev'
   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
 GROUP BY u.username
 ORDER BY topic_count DESC,
          u.username
 LIMIT 10;

SELECT COALESCE(cc.name, 'DM ' || cc.id::text) AS channel,
       COUNT(*) AS messages
  FROM chat_messages cm
  JOIN chat_channels cc
    ON cc.id = cm.chat_channel_id
  JOIN users u
    ON u.id = cm.user_id
 WHERE u.username = 'user_0277'
 GROUP BY cc.id,
          cc.name
 ORDER BY messages DESC,
          channel
 LIMIT 20;
